title: Mercy
description: Mercy means not getting the punishment we deserve. Where grace gives good gifts, mercy holds back bad ones — God is rich in both.

waypoints.title: Withholding What's Deserved
waypoints.body: Mercy and grace are close cousins: grace gives us good things we didn't earn, and mercy holds back bad things we did earn. God is rich in both toward everyone who comes to him.

waypoints.title: Shown Mercy
waypoints.body: Tell about a time someone showed you mercy -- didn't give you the consequence you expected. What did that teach you about God?
